scope: Exercise the standalone DRW_PlotSettings DWG decoder and encoder together for R2010, R2013, and R2018 object frames. This is a parser/codec regression control, not physical producer or native consumer qualification.

odaSpecification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpecification.scope: Defines the AcDbPlotSettings prefix field order embedded in LAYOUT, including the R2007+ stream split and R2004+ shade fields. The standalone PLOTSETTINGS object uses this prefix profile.

localProducerWitness.scope: Existing LibreCAD-tracked AC1015 source; used as the historical code/consumer context for the standalone object route, not as an input to this generated vector.

generatedControl.framePolicy: Construct each complete object in memory from DRW_PlotSettings::encodeDwg field streams and a direct-parser common-object frame. The synthetic object type is a parser-test placeholder and does not claim a producer class-number mapping.
fieldsChecked: page setup, printer/config, layout flags, four margins, paper dimensions/name
plot origin, units, rotation, type, window bounds, custom scale, stylesheet, paper image origin
R2004+ shade mode, resolution and custom DPI
common owner, reactor and extension-dictionary handles
R2004+ plot-view hard pointer and R2007+ shade soft pointer
generatedControl.failureRetry: Truncating the final handle-stream byte must fail, invalidate the attempted input and reset prior typed parser state. The same parser instance then reads the corrected frame and verifies all fields and handle roles.

implementation.change: Expose the existing protected PlotSettings parser only through a test probe, add generated R2007+ decode/readback and failure/retry coverage, and register one fast CTest. No format behavior, ABI or fixture files changed.

claimBoundary: The generated frame is authored from the same codec's encoder, so the vector checks parser/writer consistency and bounded failure recovery rather than independent stream bytes.
ODA §20.4.84 describes the embedded AcDbPlotSettings field sequence; this receipt does not independently prove all standalone producer variations or handle relationships.
No physical source fixture, strict whole-document graph closure, native plotting behavior, LibreCAD_3, Linux/Windows, or support claim is qualified by this test.
remaining: Continue source-bounded standalone PLOTSETTINGS field, owner/key and output binding where a physical witness identifies a gap.
Keep native consumer/platform and whole-document closure gates under P4/P8; this isolated codec vector does not close them.
